# NiceDev Web Studio

> NiceDev is a digital web engineering studio specializing in turnkey website development, bespoke UI/UX design, brand identity (logos and brandbooks), travel & hospitality booking platforms, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Overview

- **Name**: NiceDev Web Studio
- **Website**: https://nice-dev.ru
- **Contact**: info@nice-dev.ru
- **Operating Model**: 100% Remote / Distributed Studio serving clients globally without territorial boundaries.
- **Currencies Accepted**: RUB, USD, EUR, KZT, BYN, USDT.
- **Expertise**: Turnkey Web Development, Astro, React, TypeScript, Core Web Vitals 100/100, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Travel Tech Solutions.

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **Turnkey Website Development (Создание сайтов под ключ)**
   - High-speed architecture with sub-second page loads.
   - Built on modern component frameworks (Astro, React, TypeScript).
   - Core Web Vitals performance benchmarked at 100/100.
   - Full integration with payment gateways, CRM systems (Bitrix24, amoCRM, 1C), and custom APIs.

2. **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
   - Optimization for AI search engines and answer engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Яндекс Нейро, Claude).
   - Semantic Schema.org microdata (`Organization`, `FAQPage`, `Service`, `OfferCatalog`).
   - Machine-readable knowledge graphs and citation-ready content structuring.

3. **Brand Identity, Logos & Brandbooks (Дизайн логотипов и брендбука)**
   - Complete visual DNA design, typography standards, color tokens, and corporate guidelines.
   - Figma design systems, dark/light luxury design aesthetics.

4. **Digital Platforms for Tourism & Hotels (Сайты для туризма и отелей)**
   - Interactive expedition & tour itineraries.
   - Direct online booking engines without third-party aggregator commissions.
   - Channel manager integrations (Travelline, Bnovo, MyAgent).
